newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas untraded in afteroon but morning busy.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas untraded in afteroon but morning busy.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures were untraded on Wednesday afternoon after a relatively busy morning and while summer months were slightly softer, next winter was broadly unchanged.
A total of 115 lots changed hands in the morning, which constituted good volumes when compared with the dismal total of 70 lots for the entirety of last week.
July traded in the morning at 10.00 pence per therm, a fall of 0.075 pence from Tuesday's settlement, and the bids and offers had evaporated by the close of business.
No bid for August was posted and September was bid/offered at an extremely wide 10.00/11.90 pence per therm.
October through to February 1998 ended the day effectively unchanged although the tone was slightly firmer, with January and February both bid/offered at 17.65/17.90 pence a therm.
